title: backfill_checkpoint job config v1
description: ED-5 legacy A5 backfill: registers a sae_checkpoint manifest for a pre-blueprint checkpoint. store_hash is always null; the training corpus is documented via a corpus_manifest reference in `subject`.

training_config_path.description: local: URI to the original SAELens training config YAML (repo-relative), serialized verbatim into A5.config.

weights_dir_hash.description: Pre-computed directory hash (D1: MUST be computed on the machine holding the weights). If omitted, this job computes it locally -- only valid when weights_location is actually reachable from this machine.

model_dir_hash.description: Pre-computed directory hash of the base model, same rule as weights_dir_hash -- unrestricted hash_directory (ED-29). If omitted, computed locally when model_location is reachable (never true for a revision-pinned hf: location; supply it explicitly).

model_location.description: ED-29: the base model is a consumed artifact whose identity is already fixed upstream, so its ref MUST pin the revision -- 'hf:<repo>@<commit-sha>', never a mutable ref like '@main'.

telemetry_tail.description: ED-30: recovered training-run telemetry, never a certified metric. fvu_source null iff fvu is unrecoverable; dead_count follows the same nullability doctrine independently.
